database._source_table_comment: Optional: if data_table doesn't exist, it will be created as a copy of source_table
database._max_rows_comment: Optional: Maximum rows to load from database. null means no limit.
database._lazy_loading_comment: If true, uses DB-level pagination (fetches only current page data). Faster startup, less memory.
database._page_buffer_size_comment: Rows to fetch per query when lazy_loading is enabled.
database._datum_comment: Datum proxy settings (only used when mode=datum)

default_filters._comment: Default filters applied on load. Plain values use exact match. Operator objects enable rich filtering.
default_filters._operators: in, not_in, contains, not_contains, between, gt, gte, lt, lte, last_n_days, not_empty, regex

query._facet_comment: Faceted sidebar filters: columns shown as checkbox+count panels (like the status histogram but for any column)

_enable_approval_workflow_comment: Show approve/reject buttons and status column
_enable_save_button_comment: Show the save button in toolbar
_enable_status_filter_comment: Show status distribution and filter in sidebar
_enable_synthesis_comment: Enable the Synthesis feature — a long-running SQL transform whose result is materialised into a temporary PostgreSQL table with configurable TTL
_enable_review_detail_comment: Show Review Detail button in toolbar. Emits a review_detail event via commute layer with the selected row PK.

synthesis._query_comment: The SQL SELECT query to execute. Result is materialised via CREATE TABLE AS. Not user-editable at runtime.
synthesis._result_table_prefix_comment: Name for the materialised result table (shared across users)
synthesis._ttl_minutes_comment: Cache lifetime in minutes. If a cached table exists within TTL, it is served instantly. 0 = always regenerate.
synthesis.label: Synthesis
synthesis._label_comment: Human-readable label shown on the button and modal title

_status_labels_comment: Display labels for each status. Internal keys (unprocessed/edited/approved/rejected) must not change. Values in the database status_column matching these labels are also recognized.
_status_values_comment: What value to write to the database status column when Approve/Reject buttons are clicked. Change to match your column's convention, e.g. {"approved": "Accepted", "rejected": "Declined"}.
_fix_filter_comment: When true, locks filters to only the default_filters defined above. Users cannot add or remove filters.
